name: AiVisibility SEO-GEO Agent
author: John Deligiannis

sections.description:
AiVisibility SEO-GEO Agent scans published WordPress pages, posts, and WooCommerce products and creates AI-assisted SEO-GEO recommendation reports.

The plugin is report-only. It does not modify page content, metadata, headings, schema, image attributes, or other front-end output. Site administrators review the recommendations and decide which changes to make.

The WordPress plugin and its report interface are fully available without a paid plugin license. AI processing is provided by the external AiVisibility service. A newly registered domain receives 5 complimentary service credits. After those credits are used, administrators may buy additional service credits through Stripe Checkout. One service credit produces one page, post, or product recommendation report.

Main features

  • Scan published pages, posts, and WooCommerce products.
  • Generate metadata and Open Graph/social recommendations.
  • Generate JSON-LD schema recommendations only when supported by page content.
  • Review heading, keyword, and image alt text recommendations.
  • Store per-page reports in WordPress.
  • Scan one URL or run a background queue for multiple URLs.
  • View remaining AiVisibility service credits in the WordPress admin screen.
  • Start with 5 complimentary service credits and purchase more when needed.

External service disclosure

AiVisibility SEO-GEO Agent connects to the AiVisibility service to generate AI SEO-GEO recommendations, validate service credits, and create Stripe Checkout sessions for optional paid service credits.

The API endpoints are hosted on api1.aivisibility.gr, the API/server domain for the AiVisibility service at https://ai-visibility.io.

The plugin sends page/post/product scan data, site domain, site URL, plugin version, a generated site ID, SEO strategy settings, and selected business profile fields to:

  • https://api1.aivisibility.gr/v1/seo/analyze
  • https://api1.aivisibility.gr/first_requests.php
  • https://api1.aivisibility.gr/stripe/create_checkout.php

The external service validates the site domain and generated site ID, checks or updates service credits, and returns recommendation reports or Stripe Checkout links. AI provider credentials remain on the AiVisibility server and are not stored in this WordPress plugin.

Service website: https://ai-visibility.io
Privacy policy: https://ai-visibility.io/privacy/
Terms: https://ai-visibility.io/terms/
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from the WordPress Plugin Directory, or upload the aivisibility-seo-geo-agent folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate AiVisibility SEO-GEO Agent from the Plugins screen.
  3. Open the AiVisibility admin screen.
  4. Save the business details, SEO-GEO mode, and SEO strategy.
  5. Use the included complimentary service credits to scan pages, posts, or products.
  6. Buy additional service credits from the AiVisibility admin screen when needed.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin include free usage?

Yes. A newly registered domain receives 5 complimentary AiVisibility service credits. One service credit produces one page, post, or product report.

What happens after the free credits are used?

Administrators can optionally buy additional service credits from the AiVisibility admin screen. Payments are processed through Stripe Checkout.

Does the plugin modify my website?

No. This WordPress.org edition is report-only. It scans content and displays recommendations without changing page content or front-end output.

Does the plugin require an external service?

Yes. AI analysis, site verification, service-credit checks, and optional service-credit purchases use the AiVisibility service.

Does the plugin store an OpenAI API key?

No. AI provider credentials are handled server-side by AiVisibility.

  • Kept the AiVisibility logo and visible plugin title together below dynamically inserted WordPress admin notices.

0.10.72

  • Prepared the report-only package for WordPress.org review.
  • Bundled the admin logo locally, kept normal WordPress admin notices, and restored strict HTTPS certificate verification.
  • Removed public API debug-file generation and clarified the external service-credit model.

0.10.71

  • Removed BreadcrumbList and WebPage breadcrumb references from homepage recommendations while preserving validated breadcrumbs on internal pages.

0.10.70

  • Ensured the final BreadcrumbList item always uses the exact scanned page URL in recommendation reports.

0.10.69

  • Updated the plugin page URL.
  • Added strict BreadcrumbList validation that removes incomplete breadcrumb schema from recommendation reports.

0.10.68

  • Updated the report-only plugin release version.

0.10.67

  • Re-enabled Scan & Report links in WordPress content lists and disabled them while another scan or queue is running.

0.10.66

  • Removed AiVisibility row-action links from the WordPress posts and pages lists.

0.10.65

  • Initial report-only WordPress.org edition.
  • Added Scan & Report recommendations without site-content modification features.
  • Added five complimentary service credits followed by optional paid service credits.
  • Added explicit AiVisibility external service and privacy disclosures.
